messages:
maria_sales: FYI AcmeHealth asked for a final benchmark doc showing tail latency at their expected load. Need a clear run plan, cost estimate, and the minimal security items we can promise for the trial. Target baseline = 200 rps, occasional bursts to 1000 rps (2m) every 15m. Can we confirm timeline for a 24h test window?
tom_perf: I suggest phased plan: 1) warmup & cache fill (20m @ 40% traffic), 2) steady-state (1h @ 200rps), 3) burst cycles (8 cycles 2m @1000rps spaced 13m), 4) soak (2h @ 120rps with random spikes). Capture p50/p95/p99, batch sizes, and GPU sched queues.
lee_engineer: Runner example: ```rbench --model redwood-35b-int8-v2 --target https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate --qps 200 --concurrency 80 --duration 3600 --burst-pattern "1000@2m:every15m" --warmup 1200``` Also enable prefix-caching and set batching.max_tokens=96, batching.max_wait_ms=8 for steady.
ben_infra: Infra note: set two worker pools so one can be throttled to simulate saturation. Provisioned 6 x a100-like nodes for the window. I'll add a canary route that points to smaller model to measure fallback impact.
nina_se: Security checklist (minimal shareable): IdP metadata, list of test admin users, desired region, requirement for HSM (yes/no), corporate IPs for VPC allowlist. We can enable temporary VPC peering and a privatelink endpoint for the POC. Need PO to enable peering.
sam_ae: Cost ask: give me run token estimate + monthly delta if they take reserved baseline for 200rps vs on-demand. Also need a one-slide summary for procurement.
tom_perf: Quick token calc (rough): assume 45 tokens per request avg. Tokens/hr = 200 * 45 * 3600 = 32,400,000 tokens/hr. For 24h that's ~777.6M tokens. At $0.0007/1k tokens => run cost ~$544. Add infra premium for bursts + reserved discount breakdown. I'll make a small table and upload.
infra-bot: [system] Provisioning complete: 6 x a100-like nodes allocated to sales-sandbox for 2027-04-12 09:00 PT -> 2027-04-13 09:00 PT. Artifacts path: /shared/sales/acmehealth/2103456789/
lee_engineer: Metrics to log: p50/p90/p95/p99, token-count per request, batch-size histogram, request queue time, gpu_util, kv_cache_hit_pct, and per-route bytes. Also capture logs for any throttled requests.
tom_perf: I'll run an internal smoke in ~20m and post quick numbers. If p99 > 600ms during bursts we should try increasing max_wait to 20ms and enabling soft-priority for latency-sensitive routes.
maria_sales: Great. Once you post the sheet I'll package into email and slide for the customer. Nina please paste the minimal security snippet we can send directly.
nina_se: Paste: "We support SAML 2.0 (provide IdP metadata XML), temporary VPC peering or privatelink, KMS-managed keys for tenant data, SOC2/ISO27001 reports available. For HSM, please indicate requirement; additional onboarding required."
sam_ae: Adding: can we promise 99% availability during test window and a rollback to smaller model within 5m if latency > threshold?
ben_infra: Yes to SLA for the POC window (99%). We'll implement automated fallback to redwood-13b-quant when p95 breach persists >3m.
maria_sales: Perfect. Thanks team 44d Will wait for the smoke numbers and the cost spreadsheet before sending to AcmeHealth.
